facetShell.packsFootnote: Anonymous browsing; sign in to publish and subscribe. CLI usage:

facetIntro.title: A thousand facets — the pack-and-tool marketplace for AI editors
facetIntro.subtitle: Packs bundle skills, MCP references, and agent personas — browse, subscribe, publish, and install into Claude Code / Cursor in one line
facetIntro.factRow: Anonymous browsing; sign in to publish and subscribe (same identity as Platform)

contents.title: What a pack holds
contents.body: Skill sources, MCP references, and agent personas, plus version, tags, and author. The detail view exposes every skill's full text and the version history.

install.title: Subscribing and installing are two acts
install.body: A subscription is a record in the market — the same market and identity as the Store embedded in Platform. Installing is what puts content on your work surface; there are three paths.

version.title: Version snapshots
version.body: An install takes a definite version; re-running install takes a new snapshot. The CLI writes no MCP configuration and holds no credentials — credentials are wired inside Platform.

path.line1: creator --publish--> Facet market --subscribe--> Platform · one-click install into the conversation runtime
path.line2: Facet market --CLI install--> Claude Code / Cursor skill directories
path.line2Note: (skill snapshot on disk; MCP references printed)

facetIntro.quickArg: <pack id or a URL containing the id>
facetIntro.quickNote: Installs to Claude Code by default; --target cursor and --project <dir> are optional.

facetFooter.tagline: The pack-and-tool marketplace for AI editors
facetFooter.mission: FindData builds text- and data-processing infrastructure for the AI era, advancing equal access to information and, ultimately, social equity.
